name: skill-heaven
description: Working prototype of Skill Heaven for Claude Code, actively tested for public use. Dynamic skill manager and clean-context controller for coding agents. Eliminates context bloat, preserves prompt cache, and cuts token overhead by summoning specialized SKILL.md agent capabilities on-demand for a single session without permanent installation. Supports zero-default clean launches (/skill-zero) to cut ambient tools, focused gap convergence (/skill-heaven), exploratory multi-expert capability (/skill-hell), autonomous adaptive entropy routing (/skill-ultra), and one-shot ephemeral skill summoning (/summon) from remote git repositories or gaiaskilltree.com.

skill_url.title: Skill URL
skill_url.description: One source URL. Use a Skill Tree website root such as https://gaiaskilltree.com or a flat GitHub repository containing SKILL.md files.

zero_cuts.title: Zero cuts (temporary/all) skills. Default is temporary.
zero_cuts.description: "temporary" (default) cuts temporary automatic summons while manual /summon remains available. "all" cuts all skill summons, including manual /summon.
